description: This file defines a React component called AIChatWidget that renders a chat widget facilitating user interactions with an AI assistant within a web application. It manages chat messages, user roles, and integrates with backend APIs to send and receive messages, providing an interactive help chat feature tailored to user roles like learner, instructor, manager, and admin.

methods.name: getRoleFromPath
methods.description: Determines user role based on the current URL pathname.

methods.name: getRoleDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable display name for a given user role.

methods.name: getRoleHelpTopics
methods.description: Provides role-specific help topics for the chat widget.

methods.name: AIChatWidget
methods.description: Main React component implementing the AI chat widget UI and logic.
